method: Two fresh engine starts; warm-up excluded; four mixed prompts, up to 256 tokens each; MTP off; temperature 0.
conclusions: Increasing the allocated page file from 4096 to 32768 MiB increased the commit limit by 28 GiB and removed the commit-budget warning.
Measured decode throughput increased by approximately 6.16% in this short test.
Pinned RAM expert-cache size remained approximately 78 GiB; both phases already reported 0.00 decode disk reads/token at engine-log precision.
The observation does not establish that the page-file change alone caused the throughput gain.
limitations: Two repetitions per phase; A,A then B,B across a reboot; no interleaved or reverse-order test.
Automatic PCIe share and VRAM expert-cache size varied between starts; record them as confounders.
Generated token counts differed despite greedy sampling; this is a throughput comparison, not an output-equivalence validation.
Four short prompts with up to 256 generated tokens each; no long-context or concurrency test.
Disk measurements are engine-reported rounded counters, not physical storage-device I/O counters.
